$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026. Priced as a whole-property safari package (1-6 guests per night), not simple per-person sharing like most others in this batch.
region: Namunyak Wildlife Conservancy, Mathews Range (Northern Kenya, Samburu)

seasons.regular: 5 Jan-30 Jun, 1 Sep-31 Oct, 1-19 Dec 2026 (closed November 2026)

rates.unit: per night for 1-6 guests, plus per-person extras

capacity: 7 ensuite rooms (some configurable double/twin, 1 family room with double + up to 3 singles)

childPolicy.note: Any age welcome but more suitable for 5 years and over.

inclusions: Full board, soft drinks/local beers/non-premium wines/spirits, Namunyak airstrip transfers, exclusive use of vehicles, statutory taxes, laundry, day/night game drives, exclusive Reteti Elephant Sanctuary visits, montane forest hiking, horse ride, De Brazza monkey hike, guided walks, village visits.
exclusions: Community Heritage fee, blacksmithing/beading experiences, extra horse riding, Samburu dancers, champagne/premium spirits, Ololokwe day trip, fly camping mobilisation, massages.
notes: Closed 1-30 November. Community Heritage fee funds Samburu-led conservation.
